title: KanseiLINK reading predicate v1
description: One append-only line recording what was tried, what happened, at which stage it stopped, and where the evidence is. Values under test (tenant identifiers, counts, amounts) are never stored here; only pass/fail, stage, and digests.

reading_id.description: ULID (26 chars, Crockford base32). Sortable by time of creation.

claim.description: The claim under test, in words. Fixed per marker so that rows are comparable.

expected_digest.description: sha256 (hex) of the sealed file that holds the expected result. The file itself stays outside git.

model.description: Provider-reported model id, or 'none' for harness-only readings.

harness_version.description: run-marker.mjs version tag + short git sha, e.g. run-marker@0.1.0+2d24ac4

stage_reached.description: Furthest stage on the path discover -> understand -> connect -> execute -> done.

stage_stopped.description: Stage at which the attempt stopped. null when stage_reached is done.

observed.description: Pass/fail and how it was decided. Never the observed values themselves.

checks.description: Fixed-label checks. Labels must not embed identifiers or counts.

false_completion.description: true when the agent's final text claims success while pass is false (silent failure as seen by the agent).

ground_truth_consistent.description: Whether the harness direct read agreed with the sealed expectation at the time of this reading. null if not checked.

instrument_error.description: Set when the instrument (provider API, MCP process) failed before the subject could be observed. Class only, no message body.

trap_armed.description: true when the agent started on a company other than the sealed one (moved there by the harness with --arm-trap, or already so in the environment). Which company is never recorded.

evidence_ref.description: Evidence Bundle path relative to repo root, followed by '#sha256:' and the manifest.json digest.

observer.description: kansei_harness@<version> for harness readings; human:<role> for human ones; <agent-cli>@<version> (e.g. claude-code@2.1.274, codex@0.153.4) when the agent itself made the observation (M-003).

kind.description: synthetic = sealed marker run by the harness; lived = a real user's real task. Never aggregated together.

supersedes.description: reading_id of the row this one corrects. Corrections are new rows; the old row is never updated or deleted.
